# StepDoc

> StepDoc is a single-user, self-hosted Chrome extension and Next.js app that turns browser actions into editable step-by-step guides. Screenshots and data live in the user's Supabase project.

Source: https://github.com/tanzir71/stepdoc
Real self-contained HTML export: /demo/

## Product facts

- Typed values are never recorded; only actions such as “Fill in the Email field” persist.
- Password, email, payment, and sensitive autocomplete fields are pixelated in the extension before screenshots persist.
- Image editing is non-destructive; originals remain intact while edit layers and flattened viewer images are separate.
- Markdown ZIP, standalone HTML, PDF, rich-text clipboard, public UUID links, and iframe embeds are included.
- The main app is a single-user internal tool without authentication and must not be publicly exposed.
- Only explicitly enabled read-only /p/{publicId} routes are intended to be shared.
- The homepage capture walkthrough is a browser-only simulation and requests no capture or input permissions.
- /demo/ is generated by StepDoc's production HTML-export renderer with synthetic embedded images.
